name: Sorry! World
summary:
Sorry! World, the official Sorry! board game by Hasbro, brings the classic family board game to mobile as a fast, free online multiplayer game. Bump friends back to start, slam the Sorry! card, and build your own world. Play the game of Sweet Revenge.

Experience the thrill of classic board games online with brand-new twists, bold moves, and quick gameplay. Play 2 player games head-to-head or jump into full multiplayer matches online with friends and family. Born from the same classic family as Parcheesi and Ludo, Sorry! World blends the board game you grew up with and modern online play — swap, slide, and chase your way to victory while building grand cities and earning gold.

Sorry! World is an easy and free-to-play online game that can be enjoyed anywhere, anytime. Connect with players worldwide, challenge rivals, and enjoy games to compete with friends in a setting that blends nostalgia with modern gameplay.
